description: The letter's prompt offers follow_up (its instruction, then 30's mechanics sentence), and the
pinned reply leaves the macro out: the draft books no follow-up, so the model wrote no marker.
The letter is composed from the reply alone.

inputs.consult_draft: Margaret Okafor, 58, seen for type 2 diabetes with an HbA1c of 71 mmol/mol on metformin; no follow-up booked. (Fictional.)
problems: Type 2 diabetes with an HbA1c of 71 mmol/mol (fictional)

outputs.letter:
Margaret Okafor's diabetes was reviewed today; her HbA1c is 71 mmol/mol.
Metformin is continued at 1 g twice daily.
Yours sincerely, Dr A. Sample
